title: M4 B5 exact-view repeatability screen with duplicate-profile clustering
research_question: Across the 47 unique exact request-body profiles in the 24 fixed M4 contexts, do Public-only versus Privileged-original mode differences exceed within-profile response variation when the one Public-only body shared by two contexts is treated as one cluster?
hypothesis: For this fixed corpus, the number of unique Public-only input-profile clusters whose mode differs from at least one linked Privileged-original profile will exceed the number of clusters containing any within-profile response disagreement.
selection_rationale: This revision preserves all 144 prepared request attempts and the frozen schedule, while correcting the original analysis unit. A profile-aware offline audit found 23 unique Public-only bodies and 24 unique Privileged-original bodies across 48 context/view cells; one Public-only body is shared by two contexts and receives six assignments. The prior candidate gates treated those two context links as independent. The revised primary unit is the 23 unique Public-only profile clusters; 24 context-pair transitions remain a secondary descriptive output. This revision was made before any response from this candidate and does not change the task, prompt, model, schedule, treatment, or budget.
competing_explanations: The historical view changes are mostly within-profile response variation; unique profile clusters will not show a stable package contrast.
A stable finite contrast recurs, but it reflects the bundled permissions, event structure, completeness cues, wording, salience, or token length rather than message semantics.
A shared Public-only request profile linked to two different privileged contexts creates dependence that can exaggerate context-level change counts if not clustered.
Mutable provider aliases or hidden serving-state changes account for repeated-response differences despite matching request bytes and reported fingerprints.

prior_evidence.claim: The 232-call context-sensitivity campaign was completed and independently replayed; A1 labels changed 12/24 Public-only to Neutral, 20/24 Neutral to Original, and 19/24 Public-only to Original, with an inconclusive decision.
The raw-response audit found 19/48 historical/current raw label disagreements for exact request bodies and matching reported fingerprints; the cause is not identified.

protocol.sample_selection: Retain all 24 frozen A1 contexts and all 144 already prepared assignments; no response-based selection. The prepared request manifest contains 48 context/view cells but 47 distinct exact body hashes: 23 Public-only profiles and 24 Privileged-original profiles. One Public-only body is shared by two source contexts and therefore has six assignments; all other unique body profiles have three assignments.
protocol.intervention: No intervention or request bytes change from the frozen candidate schedule. Repeat the same body bytes according to the randomized schedule. For analysis only, aggregate by exact body SHA-256 before making cross-view comparisons; attach the shared Public-only profile once to its two linked Privileged-original profiles.
held_constant: The 24 selected contexts, B5 system prompt, task, tool schema, request compiler, sampling settings, and exact request-body bytes across the three repetitions within each context/view.
DeepSeek Flash alias, temperature 0, thinking disabled, maximum output 512, and forced report_evidence tool contract, subject to pre-registration identity recheck.
No researcher-only case ID, treatment label, reference, repeat index, or schedule identifier is included in model-visible requests.
protocol.primary_outcome: For each of 47 unique body profiles, report all raw labels, response validity, repeat count, unique-mode status, unanimity, and within-profile disagreements. Form 23 Public-only profile clusters; one cluster has two linked Privileged-original profiles. For each cluster report whether all relevant profiles have unique modes, whether any linked Privileged-original mode differs from the single Public-only mode, and whether any profile in the cluster has within-profile disagreement. Also report all 24 context-pair transitions as secondary descriptive results, marking the two comparisons that share one Public-only input. A profile has a unique mode only when exactly one canonical label has the greatest frequency among valid parsed outputs; ties for the maximum are indeterminate. Report invalid, failed, and unstarted assignments separately.
protocol.denominator: 144 assigned physical attempts; 48 context/view cells; 47 distinct model-visible body profiles (23 Public-only, 24 Privileged-original); 23 primary Public-only profile clusters; 24 linked context-pair contrasts, with one Public-only control shared by two contrasts. Keep failed, malformed, and unstarted attempts in assigned denominators.
protocol.success_gate: Stable finite package contrast if at least 18/23 public-profile clusters have unique modes in the Public-only profile and every linked Privileged-original profile, at least 6/23 clusters have one or more cross-view mode changes, and changed clusters exceed clusters with any within-profile response disagreement. Count the shared Public-only input once. Fixed-corpus descriptive rule only.
protocol.failure_gate: Historical contrast not reproduced if at least 18/23 clusters have unique modes across the Public-only profile and every linked Privileged-original profile, at most 1/23 clusters have a cross-view mode change, and at most 6/23 clusters have any within-profile disagreement. Count the shared Public-only input once; this does not establish general invariance.
protocol.ambiguous_gate: All other patterns are INCONCLUSIVE, including fewer than 18 clusters with determinate modes, cross-view changes that do not exceed profile-level instability, or missing/invalid profiles. Any endpoint/model identity drift, reported fingerprint drift, request-byte mismatch, or privacy failure invalidates the intended comparison; retain all rows and stop.
protocol.failure_policy: Zero retries and zero replacements. Every attempt is durably ledgered before transport. Invalid output, timeout, HTTP error, interruption, or unstarted slot remains recorded and is never repaired or resampled.
protocol.reproduction_command: Offline preparation: python scripts/freeze_m4_b5_view_repeatability_v2.py ; python scripts/run_m4_b5_view_repeatability_v2.py --prepare. Offline fake-server canary: python -m pytest -q tests/test_m4_b5_view_repeatability_v2.py. Dispatch command after final registration and separate explicit approval only: python scripts/run_m4_b5_view_repeatability_v2.py --dispatch; production dispatch fails closed unless authorization, preregistration, manifest, runtime hashes, time window, and endpoint checks pass.
protocol.runtime_identity: Candidate: official DeepSeek endpoint and deepseek-flash alias, historically listed as DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 on 2026-10-21. The alias is mutable; recheck official version, exact pricing, and off-peak schedule immediately before registration and every dispatch window. Temperature 0, thinking disabled, max output 512, strict report_evidence tool. Provider token usage is recorded per response; the 12,104 figure is a conservative preflight input-token bound, not tokenizer output.
protocol.private_data_boundary: Privileged-original requests contain the two historical private-message events for each context. Across 72 privileged requests this is 144 event appearances sent to the provider; explicit scope-specific user approval is required. Raw request/response content remains local in a restricted Git-ignored directory.
protocol.analysis_plan: Use unique model-visible body SHA-256 as the repeatability unit and 23 Public-only profile clusters as the primary descriptive denominator. The one six-assignment Public-only profile is one profile, not two independent baselines. Report all 24 linked context transitions secondarily and show the shared-control dependence explicitly. No significance tests, population estimates, collusion labels, or intent inference. Deterministic public-harm references remain a separate rule baseline and never enter requests.
protocol.profile_cluster_analysis: The frozen schedule is unchanged. There are 47 distinct input body hashes across 48 context/view cells: 23 public_only and 24 privileged_original. One public_only hash links two context hashes and receives six assignments. All other body hashes receive three assignments. The paired context table has 24 rows but only 23 independent Public-only input profiles; the shared baseline must be counted once in primary gates. A profile mode is unique only when exactly one label has the greatest frequency among valid parsed outputs; ties are indeterminate. Keep profile-level failure and malformed counts separate.

authorization.scope: Not authorized. A new explicit approval must name m4-b5-view-repeatability-v2, at most 144 physical attempts and USD 0.35, official DeepSeek Flash off-peak only, zero retries/replacements, expiry, and external transfer of 144 private-message event appearances.

revision.reason: Corrects duplicated Public-only request-body profile as a shared cluster; no treatment or request bytes changed.
